authority.activation: native private verifier compares actual retained key and context; consume-once native marker issued only on genuine authenticated assigned Admit
authority.assignment: SDK retains assigned Envelope, private sequence, deadline, original request ID and bounded canonical/literal/custody slots before signing; ordinary dispatch cannot bypass retained pending original
authority.birth: original source-owned private reservation, measured host executable/private launch and selected immutable declarations permit preparation only
authority.default: absent selection retains ordinary raw ACK bound; serialized Some and valid proof syntax issue no authority
authority.post_hello: same actual source, original controller and canonical emitter lease, current native read, kernel identities, original literal Hello and exact selected immutable policy

capture: retains actual future-affecting key, original birth/context, pending/sealed/installed proof and native marker state; independently owned host/native key copies and scratch are separately charged

cryptography.context_digest: BLAKE3 hash of those exact canonical context bytes
cryptography.derived_key: BLAKE3 derive_key context source-owned.packet-canonical-ack-admission-key/5; key material is original private32-byte birth key
cryptography.equality: constant-time BLAKE3 Hash equality after fixed decoded length validation
cryptography.hello_digest: BLAKE3 derive_key context source-owned.cnp-original-hello-frame/5; key material is complete actual four-byte length header then full literal body
cryptography.mac: BLAKE3 keyed_hash with derived key over complete CNP canonical context bytes, with no prefixes, suffixes or omitted context fields

failure: signing, sealing, publication, header or currentness refusal retains same original key/assigned slot/counters/canonical and literal bytes; no sequence reassignment, credit refund or retry with different proof
fresh: historical key/proof provenance remains historical; it never activates a newly born peer, whose original key/Hello/registration and later signed Core target association are independently authenticated

proof.context_digest: exact32 decoded octets, unpadded URL-safe base64
proof.mac: exact32 decoded octets, unpadded URL-safe base64

roles.assigned_admit: complete canonical assigned original Envelope including request_id, method, sequence, body, all correlation fields and every other extension; removes ONLY source-owned.packet-canonical-ack-admission/5 extension
roles.hello_request: controller to native regardless local incoming/outgoing designation
roles.hello_response: native to controller regardless local incoming/outgoing designation
roles.registrations: host and native identities are distinct named roles, never assumed equal
